scope: Uncommitted changes versus HEAD in onboarding_evidence.py and test_onboarding_evidence.py: contradictory CC licenses, separately credited nested illustration/table exclusion, intact source retention, and mass/masses PubMed search behavior. Clinical source pins, generated cases, release-registry changes and other files are outside this code-audit scope. No real-model calls or auditor code edits.

resolved_findings.title: Ordinary third-party credit lines could enter retained evidence
resolved_findings.initial_finding: Initial implementation retained table clinical text and its containing paragraph when the separate credit was Reproduced from, Adapted from, or Source: without an explicit permission/copyright/NCND/SA marker. This could treat separately credited material as covered by the article license.
resolved_findings.initial_reproduction: A p containing a table-wrap with <attrib>Reproduced from Example Society clinical guideline.</attrib> and an ordinary clinical cell remained in body_excerpts. Analogous Adapted from and Source: credits also remained.
resolved_findings.builder_resolution: Reject any nonempty illustration attrib, explicit reproduced/adapted/reprinted/republished/modified-from credit, or Source: marker, in addition to restrictive licenses and copyright/permission indicators. The existing parent-block check discards the entire containing paragraph.
resolved_findings.regression_quality_resolution: The shared test payload was changed from permission-controlled recommendation to clinical recommendation so credit-only cases cannot accidentally pass through the older reproduced-to-permission matcher.
resolved_findings.confirmation: Latest 71-test evidence suite passes. Independent probes with no permission/copyright wording in the clinical payload reject five representative credits across seven illustration/container tags in standalone and paragraph-nested positions (70 cases), preserving unrelated article-owned text and table content.

checks.name: contradictory_license_fail_closed
checks.details: Article licensing is checked before accepting a permissive CC BY/CC0 link. Restricted labels, Unicode dash forms, license attributes and an additional restrictive license all cause no retained full text. Exact CC-domain matching and article PMID/PMCID checks remain active. Six additional independent contradictory-label probes passed.

checks.name: restricted_nested_objects_and_context
checks.details: Candidate paragraph/table blocks scan every nested table-wrap, table-wrap-group, table, fig, fig-group, graphic and media node. A restricted or separately credited descendant causes the complete containing block to be skipped, avoiding clinical-text splicing or preservation without its associated credit.

checks.name: intact_article_owned_retention
checks.details: Compared exact complete return dictionaries against HEAD in five independent fixtures: ordinary CC BY, CC0, standard article-level third-party boilerplate, an article-owned nested table with surrounding qualifiers, and a long intact paragraph. All outputs, including hashes, were unchanged. Existing tests also preserve contraindication sections and ordinary article-owned tables.

checks.name: mass_query_precision
checks.details: The exact clinical token mass expands to grouped mass OR masses for each Title/Title-Abstract query, eliminating mass* and unintended massage matches while retaining plural recall. Other sufficiently long tokens keep their existing truncation behavior. The focused regression checks all four search combinations and both field tags.

checks.name: transport_and_evidence_integrity
checks.details: No URL-source, redirect, size-cap or network-transport behavior is broadened by this patch. Existing tests for safe fixed-host retrieval, redirects, oversized bodies, exact passage resolution, hash tampering and abstract preservation pass.

validation.result: 71 passed; 16 existing dependency/deprecation warnings; 1.15 seconds on final corrected fixture run

validation.name: Independent credit-only probes
validation.result: 70 passed; no permission/copyright words in the generic clinical payload

remaining_work: None within this code-audit scope. Source-by-source clinical/license eligibility for the upcoming generated cases remains a separate artifact audit.
